rows.en: Thank you very much! Really!
rows.es: ¡Muchas gracias! ¡De verdad!

rows.en: No, thank you! You've helped me so much too!
rows.es: ¡No, gracias a ti! ¡Me ayudaste mucho!

rows.en: Village Mayor But, are you really all right with only this?
rows.es: Anciano ¿Pero no quieres nada por la ayuda?

rows.en: We could prepare a better reward.
rows.es: Podríamos darte una recompensa.

rows.en: I am in a hurry.
rows.es: Tengo prisa.

rows.en: Even though you probably have use for my magic.
rows.es: Pero he hecho un buen uso de mi magia.

rows.en: That's why I'm so happy to receive the Teleport Gem.
rows.es: Por eso me alegra recibir la Gema Teletransporte.

rows.en: Boy Big Sis, will you come visit me again?
rows.es: Niño Hermana mayor, ¿volverás a visitarme?

rows.en: Of course! I promise!
rows.es: ¡Sí! ¡Te lo prometo!

rows.en: Boy And this time, don't mess up.
rows.es: Niño Y no te vayas a confundir.

rows.en: Yeah.
Oops, my shoelace is...
rows.es: Ups, los cordones

rows.en: I wonder if she'll be OK.
rows.es: Espero que le vaya bien.

rows.en: Large Majestic Warrior Demon Summoning-- For the experiment to go so well...
rows.es: Guerrero Noble Invocación de Demonios, para que el experimento vaya bien

rows.en: Silver-Haired Key User What a frightening power! Do we really need to use this power?
rows.es: Chica de Pelo Plateado ¡Qué gran poder! ¿En serio necesitamos usarlo?

rows.en: Large Majestic Warrior We are trying to change history. For that, we need a potent power.
rows.es: Guerrero Noble Intentamos cambiar la historia. Para ello, necesitamos un gran poder.

rows.en: It's the greatest power known!
rows.es: ¡Este es el mayor poder conocido!

rows.en: Silver-Haired Key User ...30...30...30...
rows.es: Chica de Pelo Plateado ...30...30...30...

rows.en: Large Majestic Warrior What are you thinking, Caina?
rows.es: Guerrero Noble ¿En qué estás pensando, Caina?

rows.en: Caina What is he planning, making contact with the parallel universe?
rows.es: Caina ¿Qué planea, contactar con el universo paralelo?

rows.en: Did he urge the Demon Summoning on us?
rows.es: ¿Invocó al Demonio por nosotros?

rows.en: I can't believe that man is sympathetic to our ideals.
rows.es: No me puedo creer que ese hombre acepte nuestros ideales.

rows.en: Large Majestic Warrior You don't believe in these powers?
rows.es: Guerrero Noble ¿No crees en esos poderes?

rows.en: Caina The only thing I believe in is Sir Vinsfeld himself.

rows.en: Once, there was a Blaze of Disaster that stained Filgaia with its crimson flames....606060606060
The flames from the earth scorched the heavens. The blazing whirlwinds threatened the planet's very future.606060606060
rows.es: Las llamas cubrieron hasta el cielo. Los torbellinos de fuego amenazaron el futuro del planeta.60606060606060606060

rows.en: Mankind clung to their only hope of surviving this life-or-death crisis...60606060603060
Born as the daughter of a nameless petty nobleman, she was drawn to the call of...6060606060
With no way to fight, the people cast their hopes on the Magess' sword and believed in the future.60606060606045
rows.es: Sin capacidad de luchar, la gente puso sus esperanzas en la Espada y creyeron en el futuro. 606060606060606045

rows.en: The night of the seventh day after obtaining the sword --6060606060
wrapped in a torrent of light, the <Magess> vanished from Filgaia together with the Blaze of Disaster,606060606060
rows.es: envuelta en un torrente de luz, la <Maga> desapareció de Filgaia junto a la Llama del Desastre, 6060606060606060

rows.en: The Guardian Blade |Argetlahm| began to be treated as a symbol of power.6060606060
rows.es: La Hoja Guardián "Argetlahm" empezó a considerarse un símbolo de poder.6060606060

rows.en: The battle of the <Sword Magess> remained in the hearts of the people as a familiar, ubiquitous legend.6060606060
rows.es: La batalla de la <Maga Espada> continúa en el corazón de la gente como un recuerdo familiar y lejano. 6060606060

rows.en: But the people had no idea that their familiar legends of the past would have meaning in the present...606060606060
A squad of knights trained in guerrilla tactics was established to fend off terrorists...60606060606030
rows.es: Un equipo de caballeros entrenados en tácticas de combate para luchar contra terroristas60606060606030

rows.en: and increasingly strong, brutal, and fearsome monsters, as well as an unstable world.60606060606060
rows.es: Y acabar con los monstruos cada vez más temibles que habitan este inestable mundo.6060606060606060

rows.en: The knight squad organized as a backup for Meria Boule has...6060606030
the advantage of independent authority allowing it to respond rapidly to a variety of situations.606060606060
Commander The significance of ARMS' existence lies therein.
rows.es: Capitán Ese es el significado de ARMS que debéis conocer.

rows.en: I am counting on your actions and efforts! Dismissed!
rows.es: ¡Cuento con vosotros para hacerlo bien! ¡Adelante!

rows.en: Yeah, they say it's essential to a formal knight ceremony.60606018
rows.es: Sí, dicen que es esencial para este evento de caballeros. 60606018

rows.en: But, it's the first time I've seen it.60606018
rows.es: Pues, es la primera vez que la veo. 60606018

rows.en: Those just knighted-- Blessings will be conferred upon you by the <Sword Magess>.
rows.es: Nuevos caballeros Sed bendecidos por la <Maga Espada>.

rows.en: Try to draw the Guardian Blade, Argetlahm, which banished the old blaze.
rows.es: Coged la Hoja Guardián, Argetlahm, que disipó las antiguas llamaradas.

rows.en: He who thinks he is no hero, go ahead and draw the sword.
rows.es: Quien crea ser un héroe, que intente sacar la espada.

rows.en: Here, <Sword Magess>... show us the birth of a new hero.
rows.es: Venga, <Maga Espada> Muéstranos al nuevo héroe.

rows.en: You're wasting my time. There's no way...
rows.es: Pierdes el tiempo. Es imposible

rows.en: What'd you say?
rows.es: ¿Qué decías?

rows.en: Since this ceremony first started, 100 or so years ago, no one has ever drawn the sword.
rows.es: En ninguna ceremonia desde hace 100 años o más, nadie ha conseguido sacar la espada.

rows.en: Do you understand what this means? It means it's setup from the beginning so it can't be drawn.
rows.es: ¿Entiendes el por qué? Está puesta a posta para que nadie la pueda sacar.

rows.en: As a ceremony, and as a symbol of power, the sword is meaningless.
rows.es: Como ceremonia y como símbolo de poder, no simboliza nada.

rows.en: That may be so.
rows.es: Puede ser.

rows.en: But doesn't someone have to become the hero? It's not impossible that it's me.
rows.es: ¿Pero entonces nadie es un héroe? Lo mismo soy yo.

rows.en: Ever since I was little, I have looked up to the heroes who protected everyone.
rows.es: Desde pequeño, siempre he estado portándome como uno, protegiendo a todos.

rows.en: Is that so strange?
rows.es: ¿No es extraño?

rows.en: The fact that I'm embarrassed means I've really matured.
rows.es: El hecho de avergonzarse significa que ya he madurado.

rows.en: Who cares. It's your turn.
rows.es: No importa. Es tu turno.

rows.en: Ptolomea Making an appearance like this, isn't bad, is it?

rows.en: Antenora Come again? Our mission is to capture the Pillar.

rows.en: I wish you'd not stir things up just for the heck of it.

rows.en: Ptolomea Those monsters in the cage are taken care of, right?

rows.en: Antenora Ptolomea! I already told you what our goal is!
rows.es: Antenora ¡Ptolomea, ya te dije cual es nuestro objetivo!

rows.en: Ptolomea To acquire the |Pillar,| right!
rows.es: Ptolomea ¡Tomar el "Pilar", sí!

rows.en: Forget it. We'll let the monsters loose in town to cause havoc, then grab the Pillar.
rows.es: Olvídalo. Dejarémos a los monstruos por la ciudad haciendo estragos y cogeremos el Pilar.

rows.en: It's not a lie is it? You're really back!
rows.es: ¿Es de verdad? ¡Has vuelto!

rows.en: I came back to fulfill my duty as a |hero.|
rows.es: He vuelto para cumplir mi misión como héroe.

rows.en: It seems I can't die just yet.
rows.es: Aún no ha llegado mi hora.

rows.en: I finally understand...
rows.es: Al fin entiendo

rows.en: ...why we fought and beat Odessa.
rows.es: por qué luchamos y vencimos a Odessa.

rows.en: While we were powerless and frail against such a great destructive force...
rows.es: Aunque somos menos fuertes contra tal poder de destrucción

rows.en: ...through our beliefs, we have evaded danger and discovered greater strength.
rows.es: con la confianza hemos evitado peligros y ganado mayor fuerza.

rows.en: So when one person has doubts, and cracks develop in our trust, it gets broken.
rows.es: Así que cuando una persona tiene dudas y se debilita la confianza, se rompe-

rows.en: I want the strength to save others, so I will no longer doubt my friends. I'll trust them fully.
rows.es: Quiero la fuerza para salvar a otros, no volveré a dudar de mis amigos. Confiaré plenamente.

rows.en: Somewhere along the way, I don't think I fully trusted...
rows.es: Antes creo que no confiaba plenamente en vosotros

rows.en: ...you all who are now my friends.
rows.es: y todos sois mis amigos.

rows.en: So, without going into it, it brought about suspicion.
rows.es: Así que sin quererlo, me gané sospechas.

rows.en: Listen everyone...
rows.es: Escuchad todos

rows.en: ...rather than speak the truth, if there's a way to win trust...
rows.es: antes de que digas la verdad, hay un modo de ganarte la confianza

rows.en: it's to move with you all.
rows.es: y es ir con nosotros.

rows.en: But I don't plan on having contact with you all.
rows.es: Pero yo no quiero tener ningún contacto contigo.

rows.en: My goal is to exorcise the demon that possesses !
rows.es: ¡Mi objetivo es exorcizar al demonio que posee a !

rows.en: Bonds formed in battle are the strongest.
rows.es: Los lazos en combate son los más fuertes.

rows.en: That's what I learned on the battlefield.
rows.es: Es lo que aprendí en el campo de batalla.

rows.en: Ties have already been established between us.
rows.es: Ya hay unos vínculos entre nosotros.

rows.en: King of Meria Boule This is...this ghastly thing is the battle risking Filgaia's fate...
rows.es: Rey de Meria Boule Esta es la horrible batalla por el destino de Filgaia

rows.en: ...the battle of the |heroes.|
rows.es: la batalla de los "héroes".

rows.en: {2} No, Sir.
rows.es: {2} No, Señor.

rows.en: Everyone has weaknesses and frailties. They are humans just like us.
rows.es: Todos tenemos debilidades. Ellos son humanos como nosotros.

rows.en: They're humans who shed tears and blood. They get hurt and ragged, but still fight.
rows.es: Lloran y sangran. Son heridos, pero siguen luchando.

rows.en: {2} It's not a battle of |heroes.|
rows.es: {2} No es una batalla de "héroes".

rows.en: It's people just like us fighting...
rows.es: Solo es gente como nosotros luchando

rows.en: So, we have to fight with them.
rows.es: Así que tenemos que ayudarles.

rows.en: King of Meria Boule But I am powerless... Fighting is...
rows.es: Rey de Meria Boule Pero sin poder Luchar es

rows.en: {2} Let's believe... That'll be our battle.
rows.es: {2} Confiemos Será nuestra batalla.

rows.en: To offer a prayer... Intense feelings always reach the intended.
rows.es: Rezando Los sentimientos con fuerza siempre se cumplen.

rows.en: To one's prayers and goodwill distance makes no difference no matter how far it is.
rows.es: El deseo de los que rezan no depende de la distancia.

rows.en: I don't want to let go of the hands clasped.
rows.es: No me quedaré de brazos cruzados.

rows.en: {5} Our support won't reach from here! We need to move closer, {6}!!
rows.es: {5} ¡No les ayudaremos desde aquí! ¡¡Tenemos que acercarnos, {6}!!

rows.en: {6} In my opinion, the power of emotions is simply unrealistic!
rows.es: {6} ¡Opino que, el poder de las emociones es irreal!

rows.en: But...
rows.es: Pero

rows.en: To not be able to believe in my friends here and now... that isn't a world worth...
rows.es: No poder apoyar a mis amigos ahora no está bien

rows.en: It's not logic! It's my own conclusion!
rows.es: ¡No es lógico! ¡Esa es mi conclusión!

rows.en: What? What is it?
rows.es: ¿Dónde estoy?

rows.en: {0} It's clear that physical attacks on the |parallel universe,| a
rows.es: {0} Está claro que los ataques físicos al universo paralelo

rows.en: conceptual being, are meaningless. So, think of the universe as a lifeform. Consider it a...
rows.es: no tendrían sentido. Pensando en ello como una forma de vida

rows.en: |spirit| and seal it in a vessel. In essence, the flesh that should have been destroyed is created.
rows.es: Decidí sellar su "espíritu" en un receptor.

rows.en: It's what I suggested to Odessa ...by using the Demon Summoning my sister will have inside her...
rows.es: En esencia, teniendo un cuerpo puede ser destruido.

rows.en: By making {1} a vessel, the abominable lifeform will...
rows.es: Es lo que le propuse a Odessa, usar la invocación dentro de mi hermana

rows.en: Stop!
rows.es: ¡Para!

rows.en: How far will you go to achieve your goals?
rows.es: ¿Hasta dónde llegarás para conseguirlo?

rows.en: Are you saying you offered your own sister as a sacrifice?
rows.es: ¿Vas a sacrificar a tu propia hermana?

rows.en: {0} It wasn't to be a sacrifice, but to be a |hero.|
rows.es: {0} No será un sacrificio, sino ser una "heroína".

rows.en: Not the <Sword Magess>, but the Madonna of Destruction summoned under Valeria's name.
rows.es: No como la <MagaEspada>, sino como la Señora de la Destrucción, invocada por un Valeria.

rows.en: never wanted anything like this!
rows.es: ¡ nunca quiso algo así!

rows.en: {0} I don't expect you to forgive me.
rows.es: {0} No espero que me perdones.

rows.en: In order to save Filgaia, I had no choice.
rows.es: Para salvar a Filgaia, no tuve elección.

rows.en: We have to destroy the Kuiper Belt on our own!
rows.es: ¡Tienes que destruir al Kuiper Belt!

rows.en: Before my consciousness gets swallowed up...
rows.es: Antes de que mi conciencia también sea devorada

rows.en: Is it already too late?
rows.es: ¿Ya es demasiado tarde?

rows.en: {0} I know myself better than anyone else.
rows.es: {0} Lo sé mejor que nadie.

rows.en: But it's strange. Even though I know we'll slash each other, I have no fear or regrets.
rows.es: Pero es extraño. Aunque sé que lucharemos no tengo miedo o arrepentimientos.

rows.en: I'm happy.
rows.es: Estoy feliz.

rows.en: I'm happy I had the opportunity to be with you all, rather than am sad we won't see each other again.
rows.es: Feliz por la oportunidad de estar con vosotros, además de triste porque no os volveré a veros.

rows.en: I'm really happy I got to be with you all and that we could protect Filgaia together.
rows.es: Estoy muy feliz de estar con todos vosotros y que podamos proteger juntos a Filgaia.

rows.en: I promised that I'd stop Valeria's suffering.
rows.es: Le prometí a que acabaría con tu sufrimiento.

rows.en: {0}, {1}... Let's fight together!

rows.en: Whoa! What in the world happened?
rows.es: ¡Guau! ¿Qué demonios ha pasado?

rows.en: Where is everyone? Where am I?
rows.es: ¿Dónde estoy? ¿Y los demás?

rows.en: Voice Heard Somewhere It's the world where |I| am. It's where the destruction began.
rows.es: Voz de alguna parte Soy de este mundo. De donde comienza la destrucción.

rows.en: Who are you?
rows.es: ¿Quién eres?

rows.en: Voice Heard Somewhere Lord Blazer...
rows.es: Voz de alguna parte Lord Blazer

rows.en: You ask who I am? That's harsh after we've been together for so long and even fought, too.
rows.es: ¿Preguntas quién soy? Es duro tras haber estado juntos tanto tiempo, incluso luchando.

rows.en: No! You are the disaster that turned Filgaia red with fire.
rows.es: ¡No! Eres el desastre que cubrió de llamas a Filgaia.

rows.en: Lord Blazer I've finally been freed from those chains. Great to have a body again.
rows.es: Lord Blazer Al fin me he liberado de esas cadenas. Me alegra tener cuerpo.

rows.en: I owe you my thanks.
rows.es: Te lo agradezco.

rows.en: It was my good fortune to live inside your body after being trapped behind the Event Horizon.
rows.es: Fue mi suerte el vivir dentro de tu cuerpo tras ser atrapado más allá del Horizonte de Sucesos.

rows.en: The negative feelings that grew inside you during battles are now the food that sustains me.
rows.es: Los sentimientos negativos que crecieron en ti durante la batalla me han mantenido.

rows.en: My negative feelings? You're saying I helped resurrect you?!
rows.es: ¿Mi sentimientos negativos? ¡¿Dices que te ayudé a revivir?!

rows.en: Lord Blazer It's not just you.
rows.es: Lord Blazer No solo tú.

rows.en: Swirling inside all humans are the most unsightly and strong energy forces.
rows.es: El interior de los humanos es el mayor de los poderes oscuros.

rows.en: In your battles you've seen the true nature of people and it's that negativity that I feed on.
rows.es: Durante tus batallas has visto el poder y la negatividad de la que me alimento.

rows.en: I'll give you the honor of witnessing the world burning into oblivion.
rows.es: Tendrás el honor de ver al mundo ardiendo hasta su fin.

rows.en: Stop it! Now!
rows.es: ¡Para ahora!

rows.en: Lord Blazer Are you going to draw it? That abominable Argetlahm.
rows.es: Lord Blazer ¿Vas a enfrentarte a mí? Esa maldita Argetlahm.

rows.en: Lord Blazer That is definitely the absolute perfect sword to destroy me.
rows.es: Lord Blazer Esa es la espada definitiva para destruirme.

rows.en: But don't say you forgot that you weren't able to draw the Argetlahm.
rows.es: Pero no te habrás olvidado de que no podías envainarla.

rows.en: Once you had my strength, the strength you tried to destroy, then you finally got the sword.
rows.es: Una vez que tengas mi poder, el poder que intentas destruir, tendrás la espada.

rows.en: Now that I'm free of your body, you're only a mere human. You cannot draw Argetlahm.
rows.es: Ahora que estoy libre de tu cuerpo, solo eres un simple humano. No puedes usar la Argetlahm.

rows.en: Argetlahm is meant to be wielded by the |Hero of the Sword.|
rows.es: La Argetlahm solo puede ser usada por el "Héroe de la Espada".

rows.en: Lament the era of no |heroes!| And live in fear of the future that will burn to smithereens.
rows.es: ¡Lamenta estar en la era sin héroes! Vive con miedo al futuro que arderá hasta las cenizas.

rows.en: It's definite I'm not the |hero| chosen by the sword.
rows.es: Definitivamente no soy el "héroe" elegido.

rows.en: Lord Blazer Then, why struggle? Don't resist me! Accept the future!
rows.es: Lord Blazer ¿Entonces por qué te resistes? ¡Acepta el futuro!

rows.en: The world we live in... the all-important Filgaia...
rows.es: El mundo en el que vivimos es todo importante

rows.en: ...is not such a puny world that it's sustained by the power of only a |hero.|
rows.es: no es un mundo débil sostenido por el poder de un único "héroe".

rows.en: This world is full of the interactions and exchanges of the people and their thoughts, so...
rows.es: Este mundo está lleno de gente que se relaciona y comparte sus ideas, así que

rows.en: ...the power that sustains the universe exists in Filgaia. It's the power of all life!
rows.es: el poder que sostiene el universo existe en Filgaia. ¡Es el poder de la vida!

rows.en: A time without |heroes|... That's what you said.
rows.es: Una era sin "héroes" Eso dijiste.

rows.en: No. No. Not |without| heroes, but an era that doesn't need heroes.
rows.es: No. No. No "sin" héroes, sino una era que no necesita héroes.

rows.en: We don't need a |hero|!!!!
rows.es: ¡¡¡No necesitamos un héroe!!!

rows.en: There's no value in a world protected by such things.
rows.es: Un mundo protegido así no tiene ningún valor.

rows.en: If everyone's hearts become one, then we can rise and stand together.
rows.es: Si nuestros corazones se hacen uno, podremos avanzar y estar juntos.

rows.en: We can support the world without sacrificing a |hero.| Miracles can happen!
rows.es: Podemos ayudar al mundo sin sacrificar a un "héroe". ¡Pueden ocurrir milagros!

rows.en: We can never make the same mistake {0} made.
rows.es: Jamás volveremos a cometer el mismo error que {0}.

rows.en: I can tell now. Our hearts are becoming one.
rows.es: Ahora lo sé. Nuestros corazones se unen.

rows.en: The Argetlahm isn't something to be pulled out by the hero alone.
rows.es: La Argetlahm no está hecha para un héroe solo.

rows.en: Lord Blazer Is that figure the |Hero of the Sword?| ...from Argetlahm?!
rows.es: Lord Blazer ¿Esa es la forma del "Héroe"? ¡¿De Argetlahm?!

rows.en: Let's go. Let's all go fight this together!
rows.es: Vamos. ¡Luchemos todos juntos!

rows.en: That's it. That's it exactly!
rows.es: Eso es. ¡Eso es exactamente!

rows.en: The Argetlahm isn't a weapon to bury demons.
rows.es: La Argetlahm no es un arma para matar demonios.

rows.en: By gathering the will to live into power, it becomes the key to open the door to the future.
rows.es: Sino para convertir la voluntad de vivir en poder, es la llave para abrir la puerta al futuro.

rows.en: It's not a power to be wielded alone. It's a power for everyone to wield together.
rows.es: No es un poder para llevar uno. Es un poder para todos juntos.

rows.en: {3} Has it arrived? Has my prayer arrived?
rows.es: {3} ¿Ha llegado? ¿Ha llegado mi oración?

rows.en: If it won't arrive when I pray alone, we'll pray together as one.
rows.es: Si no llega rezando sola, rezaremos todos juntos.

rows.en: Everyone, everyone was born on this star, and lived here.
rows.es: Todos, todos nacimos en este mundo y vivimos aquí.

rows.en: B Everything depends on being alive.
rows.es: B Todos dependemos de estar vivos.

rows.en: Only when you're alive do you get to fall in love or get to fight with others.
rows.es: Solo cuando vives te enamoras o luchas con otros.

rows.en: If tomorrow comes because today's life light starts the creation of the future then...
rows.es: Si viene el mañana por la vida que creamos

rows.en: ...this light should be delivered to those battling at the end of today!
rows.es: ¡Deberíamos apoyar a los que luchan!

rows.en: Noel I can clearly feel it!
rows.es: Noel ¡Lo puedo sentir!

rows.en: Right now, all the souls in Filgaia are trying to join together!
rows.es: ¡Todas las almas de Filgaia se están intentando reunir!

rows.en: It's stopping all life from fighting simply to keep alive.
rows.es: Está deteniendose luchando por seguir con vida.

rows.en: We are not powerless! We have the strength of our united hearts.
rows.es: ¡Tenemos poder! Tenemos la fuerza de estar unidos.

rows.en: Take this power and throw it against the wars confronting you!
rows.es: ¡Toma este poder y lánzaselo al enemigo!

rows.en: Merrill This battle is to save our precious world!
rows.es: Merrill ¡Esta es la batalla para salvar nuestro mundo!

rows.en: That's why we must fight too!
rows.es: ¡También debemos luchar!

rows.en: We don't need to be protected by someone special.
rows.es: No necesitamos que nos proteja alguien especial.

rows.en: Because it's important, so very important, we must protect it ourselves.
rows.es: Porque es importante, muy importante, y debemos protegernos a nosotros mismos.

rows.en: If someone has to be the |hero,| then anyone should be able to become the |hero.|
rows.es: Si alguien tiene que ser un "héroe", cualquiera debería serlo.

rows.en: The prayers must have reached them, right? Everyone is fighting to protect Filgaia now.
rows.es: ¿Las oraciones los deben haber alcanzado, verdad? Todos están luchando para proteger Filgaia.

rows.en: {5} We're not going to push it all off on Dude.
rows.es: {5} Tío, no vamos a dejarte que hagas todo.

rows.en: Because it's so important, we're going to protect it with our own hands.
rows.es: Porque esto es muy importante, nosotros te protegeremos.

rows.en: I'm not sure we can handle it on our own, so if we get into trouble, help us out, Dude. OK?
rows.es: No estoy seguro de que podamos solos, pero si estás en problemas te ayudaremos, ¿vale, colega?

rows.en: When you get into a bind, the Young ARMS could help you out in return.
rows.es: Cuando estés en un aprieto, Joven ARMS te ayudará a que vuelvas.

rows.en: We like Filgaia just like everyone else!
rows.es: ¡Nos gusta Filgaia como a todos los demás!

rows.en: {2} I love it!
rows.es: {2} ¡Me encanta!

rows.en: This world, the life we live, and all...
rows.es: Este mundo, nuestra vida, y

rows.en: I like today better than yesterday, and I like the unknown tomorrow even more.
rows.es: Me gusta hoy más que ayer, y el mañana que desconocemos aún más.

rows.en: Let's all head off to tomorrow together.
rows.es: Dirijámonos todos juntos al mañana.

rows.en: Everyone together...
rows.es: Todos juntos

rows.en: So, it's finally over.
rows.es: ¿Entonces se acabó?

rows.en: We won, right? won, right?
rows.es: ¿Ganamos? ¿ ganó, verdad?

rows.en: I wasn't the one that won.
rows.es: No fui el único que ganó.

rows.en: Everyone here and everyone waiting for us, and...
rows.es: Todos nos estaban esperando, y

rows.en: Well... it's a victory we won together.
rows.es: Bien lo conseguimos juntos.

rows.en: I'm not a |hero!| It's the future we grabbed hold of for ourselves.
rows.es: ¡No soy un héroe! Nosotros mismos somos nuestros héroes.

rows.en: Come on, give me a break!
rows.es: ¡Venga, dame un respiro!

rows.en: Don't hassle me. I refuse to ever do such unsuitable work!
rows.es: Di lo que quieras, pero no me veo haciendo de heroína.

rows.en: Let's go home together. Let's all go home to Filgaia.
rows.es: Regresemos a casa juntos. Volvamos a Filgaia.

rows.en: No matter what you say, humans are strange creatures.6060606060606060Besides being frail, people get lost along the way and make false moves.606060606060606060606060Then they sometimes don't realize their mistakes and hurt those who are close.6060606060606060Yet at the same time, they know how to link arms and band together. If you ask why, must you answer so?60606060606060606060While acknowledging their own weaknesses, when they take aim at a far off goal, they join hands.606060606060606060606060Those who extend a hand and those who take the hand, can't be done without trust.606060606060606060606060Hold on there just a minute. It's not clear if humans are weak or strong from this.6060606060606060606060606060Well then, I'll try to explain it. A Crimson Noble's time is eternal.60606060606060

A broken clock starts to move to some rhythm.6060606060606060A clock that had stopped like that starts to move.6060606060606060Stories always start suddenly. Focus your eyes, listen closely, and pay attention.6060606060606060606060The life starting now is even more unpredictable than the battlefield.60606060606060606060To be honest, if I were thrown out on my own, I'd be apprehensive.6060606060606060Yet, that doesn't mean I'd just stop.60606060606060You're on my side. Better still, I have friends who'll fight beside me. Next time I'll have them help.60606060606060606060A real |hero| is very cool, but I'd never be able to fill that role. rows.es: Así es como me haré fuerte. Es como se consigue el poder.

rows.en: Aisha So, I too discarded my own self?
rows.es: Aisha ¿También me deshice de mí misma?

rows.en: Gulp.
rows.es: Gulp.

rows.en: That's it. If I don't do it, I'll never be able to be a |hero.|
rows.es: Eso es. Si no lo hago, jamás podré ser una "heroína".

rows.en: I wasn't able to acquire the power to exorcise evil!
rows.es: ¡No pude conseguir el poder para exorcizar el mal!

rows.en: Aisha It's an odd story.
rows.es: Aisha Es una historia rara.

rows.en: But if you've got the blood of the <Sword Magess> flowing within you, why did you throw away your body?
rows.es: Pero si tienes la sangre de la <MagaEspada>, ¿por qué te echaste a perder tu cuerpo?

rows.en: That was to...
rows.es: Eso fue para

rows.en: Aisha Tell me.
rows.es: Aisha Dime.

rows.en: All those years past, if I had endured the abuses of a bionic body, I would have become a |hero?|
rows.es: Esos años pasados, si hubiese resistido un cuerpo biónico, ¿habría sido una "heroína"?

rows.en: Am I somehow different from the other Mercs?
rows.es: ¿Me diferencio en algo de los demás Mercs?

rows.en: Why did I want to become a |hero?|
rows.es: ¿Porque quería ser una "heroína"?

rows.en: Aisha I remember.
rows.es: Aisha Lo recuerdo.

rows.en: I was raised hearing my mother tell stories about the <Sword Magess>.
rows.es: De pequeña escuchaba las historias de mi madre sobre la <MagaEspada>.

rows.en: I always hoped that I had the blood of the <Sword Magess> within me.
rows.es: Siempre esperé tener la sangre de la <MagaEspada>.

rows.en: I always thought that if I were a |hero,| I'd be able to get out of this situation.
rows.es: Pensaba que si era una "heroína", podría acabar con esta situación.

rows.en: That's right.
rows.es: Es cierto.

rows.en: I always thought about how to escape from that dark slum. And I...
rows.es: Siempre pensaba en escapar de ese barrio miserable. Y yo

rows.en: Aisha ...made the |hero| the authority. That's how it was, right?
rows.es: Aisha tomé el papel de "heroína". ¿Eso pasó, verdad?

rows.en: But I was always lonely.
rows.es: Pero siempre estaba sola.

rows.en: A world just like that slum had spread everywhere.
rows.es: Había un mundo como ese barrio en todas partes.

rows.en: Aisha What I sought wasn't a |hero.|
rows.es: Aisha Me estaba equivocando.

rows.en: I wanted a group of friends who needed me.
rows.es: Quería un grupo de amigos que me necesitasen.

rows.en: So you wanted to be needed. That's why you tried to be a |hero,| right?
rows.es: Así que querías ser necesitada. ¿Por eso intentaste ser una heroína, verdad?

rows.en: That's right. That's why I wanted to be a |hero,| to find...
rows.es: Así es. Por eso quería ser una heroína. Para encontrar

rows.en: a place where I belonged, a place of friends.
rows.es: un lugar al que pertenecer un lugar de amigos.

rows.en: But...
rows.es: Pero

rows.en: Aisha Why do I feel so estranged even when everyone's by my side?
rows.es: Aisha ¿Por qué me siento tan distante cuando alguien está conmigo?

rows.en: You should know...
rows.es: Deberías saberlo

rows.en: Because I refused everyone...
rows.es: Porque rechacé a todos

rows.en: Aisha Be brave and reach out your hand...
rows.es: Aisha Sé valiente y extiende tu mano

rows.en: If I do that, they'll probably accept me.
rows.es: Si lo hago, seguramente me aceptarán.

rows.en: Aisha The belief becomes the bind that ties me to them.
rows.es: Aisha La fe es lo que nos une.

rows.en: Aisha Accept and recognize me as one of the group.
rows.es: Aisha Acéptame y reconóceme como una del grupo.

rows.en: Broken bionic implants can only shorten one's life.
rows.es: Los implantes biónicos rotos solo acortan la vida.

rows.en: Don't refuse me. It'll help me get back my original body of living flesh.
rows.es: No me rechaces. Ayúdame a volver a mi cuerpo original de carne viva.

rows.en: My real self...
rows.es: Mi yo real

rows.en: Aisha Let's go home together, to Aisha Bernadette.
rows.es: Aisha Regresemos juntas a casa, Aisha Bernadette.

rows.en: Did you know that all the arms we carry are manufactured in Guild Galad?
rows.es: ¿Sabes que todas las armas que llevamos se fabrican en el Gremio Galad?

rows.en: The country's resource called a |Fossil| was used to develop mechanical techniques.
rows.es: El país tiene unos recursos llamados "Fósiles" y se usan para crear Maquinas.

rows.en: Progress is slow. If we'd pump up the nation's weaponry, the monsters can be demolished.
rows.es: El progreso es lento. Así que debemos armarnos bien para defendernos de los monstruos.

rows.en: The ARMS emblem being designed now has a motif of a watchdog.
rows.es: El emblema de ARMS es un perro.

rows.en: It's not right. It feels like we're the |National Pet| What do you think?
rows.es: Es raro, se parece a la "mascota nacional". ¿Tú qué crees?

rows.en: It looks like our next mission has not been officially determined yet.
rows.es: Parece que aún no nos han ordenado ninguna misión oficialmente.

rows.en: But it won't be long before some booming voice calls us.
rows.es: Pero no tardarán en ordenarnos que iniciemos alguna misión.

rows.en: I mean, it's almost guaranteed we'll be assigned to the front line.
rows.es: Quiero decir que es casi seguro que estaremos en primera línea.

rows.en: What, you have a Medium too?
rows.es: ¿Qué, también tienes un Médium?

rows.en: Just by re-outfitting us, our tactic options increase. How very convenient.
rows.es: Con más provisiones, tendremos más opciones en combate. Son útiles.

rows.en: I don't know the other's back- grounds, but it's not how it looks. I'm an ex-mercenary soldier.
rows.es: No sé como son los demás en el fondo, pero no es lo que parece. Yo soy ex-mercenario.

rows.en: I was involved in the Slayheim War 5 years ago. Of course I fought for the Liberation Army.
rows.es: Estuve en la guerra de Slayheim hace 5 años. Claro que yo luché para el Ejército de Liberación.

rows.en: The other night I saw a huge comet streak across the sky.
rows.es: La otra noche vi un gran cometa cruzando el cielo.

rows.en: I recall my grandmother saying comets were an omen of evil.
rows.es: Mi abuela solía decir que los cometas traían mala suerte.

rows.en: It's not possible that matter suddenly develops out of nothing without reason.
rows.es: No es posible que pasen las cosas de repente sin ninguna razón.

rows.en: But the monsters just keep multiplying.
rows.es: Pero cada vez hay más monstruos.

rows.en: Where in the world are they all coming from?
rows.es: ¿De dónde vienen?

rows.en: I'm so nervous. My first appearance. I wish my mom back home could see me now.
rows.es: Estoy nervioso. No lo he vivido antes. Ojalá mi madre pudiese volver a casa.

rows.en: On this job, I sure feel sorry for guys with girlfriends.
rows.es: Este trabajo no es para tipos que tengan novias.

rows.en: For me, ever since I was born, I never once managed such troublesome things!
rows.es: ¡Por lo menos yo, nunca me he metido en esos problemas!

rows.en: So, what about you?
rows.es: ¿Y tú que tal?

rows.en: It looks like we're a part of the Special Forces.
rows.es: Parece que somos parte de las Fuerzas Especiales.

rows.en: In other words, we're being assigned to the most dangerous front.
rows.es: En otras palabras, asignados al puesto más peligroso.

rows.en: I wonder how many of us will still be alive 6 months from now.
rows.es: Me pregunto cuantos de nosotros seguiremos con vida dentro de 6 meses.

rows.en: Since ARMS emphasizes the soldiers' skills, personal backgrounds aren't screened.
rows.es: Las ARMS destacan las habilidades sin importar la formación que tengas.

rows.en: Look around you. Aren't there a lot of shady-looking guys here?
rows.es: Mira a tu alrededor. ¿No hay un montón de tipos con pinta de novatos?

rows.en: So, you're originally from the Town of Meria.
rows.es: Así que eres realmente de Meria.

rows.en: The soldiers here are from all over.
rows.es: Aquí cada soldado es de un sitio diferente.

rows.en: They're more interested in your skills than your nationality.
rows.es: Están más interesados en tu habilidad que en tu nacionalidad.

rows.en: We're counting on you. Best of luck to you all.
rows.es: Contamos con vosotros. Que tengáis suerte.

rows.en: For some reason, I'm nervous. There's no reason why I should be nervous but...
rows.es: Por algún motivo estoy nervioso. No sé por qué

rows.en: who, with a Wolf beside her and Argetlahm in hand, saved the world.
*Since then, the lineage of the <Sword Magess> is seen as the lineage of a |hero.|
*But no one on the planet is directly descended from the <Sword Magess>.
*The family line was carried on, but the blood got diluted and the |hero's| ancestors spread.
*How much value is placed on |blood?| The <Sword Magess> herself said blood doesn't make a |hero.|
disaster to fight in order to become a |hero.|
*The reverse is also true. When a |hero| appears, |disaster| follows. They are 2 sides of the same coin.
*A |hero| isn't born. It's something you know as a result of actions.
the event horizon, the <Magess> thrust Argetlahm into stone.
*Many knights and heroes have vied for the Argetlahm, but all have failed.
*Even blood relatives of the <Sword Magess> couldn't retake the sword.
*The Argetlahm thrust in the earth acts as if it rejects all but the <Sword Magess>.
*The cathedral devoted to the <Sword Magess> had the pedestal enshrined. Even the stone itself was removed.
the <Sword Magess>' Sanctuary.
*This is land the <Sword Magess> acquired under the direction of Argetlahm.
*To exorcise the disasters covering the earth, a ray of hope was directed toward us.
*Many worshippers visit here, where the hero who saved Earth was born.
*The Argetlahm is publicly displayed a few times a year for worshippers.
|Despair,| light shined. That's the <Sword Magess>.
*Alone, the <Sword Magess> confronted the Demon. She alone shouldered the burden.
*But the <Sword Magess> wasn't able to destroy the Blazing Demon, only contain it.
*In exchange for world peace, the <Sword Magess> was offered as a |sacrifice.|
many knights and heroes were destroyed by the Blazing Demon.
*Even the weapons developed with the lost technology were a cool breeze on the Blazing Demon.
*The <Sword Magess>, armed with the Argetlahm, was the entire resistance.
*It is still a mystery why only the <Sword Magess> was able to battle the Blazing Demon on equal footing.
forget about the Blazing Demon.
*He wasn't |destroyed| but was only |contained.|
*The seal will eventually be broken.
*The Blazing Demon will crush the <Sword Magess>, then Filgaia.
*No one knows when the seal will be broken.
*Whether it will be 100 years or 1000 years or tomorrow, we have no magic to resist.
negativity to bring on |Disasters.|
*The spreading negativity knows no limits.
*The |disasters| continue to spread without end.
*When a ray of light doesn't shine, beyond negativity is only a road to |destruction.|
*Know that what strangles you in the end is your negativity.
chosen by Argetlahm, she was only a girl who had never held a sword.
*She wasn't a prominent soldier, nor a knight who'd sworn loyalty to her country. She was just a girl.
*That the Argetlahm couldn't be retrieved only deepens the mystery.
*When someone who can hold the Argetlahm appears again, the mystery will be solved.
After the Demon wraps itself in the blaze, only destruction remains.
*Nothing lives in the dying earth.
*The earth is colored red by blood. Flames of the red lotus will burn everything into a world dyed red.
*In the world not one ray of hope. What waits is |death,| the journey to the other side.
*Without |hope,| the world is dark. People's cries echo, dark clouds circle. Souls are locked in grief.
Guardian Blade Argetlahm and the Black Wolf Lucied.
*The Argetlahm diverts all possible disasters.
*The Black Wolf Lucied shields the <Sword Magess> from all possible disasters.
*To watch the <Sword Magess> fight is to watch the queen of war. She gives the people a glimmer of hope.
